no_adcom_quote.quote: An advisory committee was not convened for this application. After initial review of the data the Agency decided that the efficacy and safety were sufficiently robust that holding up approval to discuss at an advisory committee meeting was not necessary.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the Kalydeco (ivacaftor) NDA203188 approval. A Pulmonary-Allergy Drugs Advisory Committee (PADAC) meeting was originally planned to discuss the safety and efficacy of VX-770, but after initial review the Division/Agency determined the efficacy and safety were sufficiently robust that delaying approval for an AC discussion was unnecessary, and the ODMemo noted there were no controversial issues or significant public health questions warranting advisory committee input. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven concern-to-change linkages.
